'''Imperial Task Force Vengeance''' was the name of an operation undertaken by [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']], an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] task force commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn]], in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Timeline of battles==
#[[Battle near the Blair Cluster]] - Interdiction mission against Rebel smugglers
#[[Attack on Goff]] - Capture of an Airam base defended by a Rebel frigate
#[[Battle of Rocrin]] - Strike against a Rebel convoy carrying construction equipment to Nocto
#[[Attack on the Compellor|Attack on the ''Compellor'']] - Rebel ambush targeting Interdictor ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]''
#[[Attack on Soren|Attack on ''Soren'']] - Destruction of Rebel Facility ''[[Soren]]''
#[[Skirmish at Klaatu]] - Baited trap for Airam pirates
#[[Battle at Essebra]] - Defending [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] during starfighter resupply
#[[Battle at the Hinda Repair Yards]] - Strike against Rebel capital ships
#[[Battle of Aiqin 4]] - Meeting between Imperial agents and Airam clan leader
#[[Skirmish at Elbra]] - Imperial attack on Rebel convoy
#[[Battle of Swellen]] - Defense against Rebel attack on Imperial repair yard
#[[First Battle of Bes]] - Rebel ambush of [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']]
#[[Second Battle of Bes]] - Second wave Rebel attack at Bes
#[[Skirmish at Nocto]] - Imperial reconnaissance of Nocto system
#[[Battle of Nocto]] - Destruction of Rebel shipyard ''[[Calenz]]''

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power]]''
